instructions: Follow AGENTS.md. Planevo is an ecosystem (Tasks, Calendar, Files, Workspace as separate products), never a Notion clone or database-face architecture. Flag hardcoded colors/fonts/px, marigold used more than once per screen, and secrets in commits.

rules.rule: Never commit API keys, tokens, private keys, or .env values. Flag any credential-looking literals.
Do not hardcode hex colors, font names, or arbitrary pixel type sizes. Use CSS custom properties / Tailwind theme tokens from globals.css.
Do not reintroduce kernel-first patterns (DatabaseFace, template_type faces for Tasks/Calendar/Files). Products stay independent and link via workspace_links.
Never mutate Date instances or cached calendar payloads in place. Day arithmetic must use local-day helpers, not raw millisecond day adds.
